description: Recognized as the sole recipient among 120 students in the first year of B.E. CSE (AI and ML) for exemplary conduct, discipline, and positive contribution to the college community.
Received the department-level Best Extra-Curricular award as the only selected student among 120 classmates for sustained performance beyond the classroom.
Selected as the only student among 120 in the batch for outstanding co-curricular performance, initiative, and contribution during the third year of B.E. CSE (AI and ML).
Led the We Code Debuggers team to third place in Code Hunt 2025, coordinating the team's problem-solving approach and technical execution.
Attended the NCC ATC Camp in 2024 and led a complete school of 75 cadets as a leading cadet while the college team achieved runner-up position among participating colleges.
Successfully completed the NCC B Certificate examination with an A grade, demonstrating strong performance in training, discipline, and cadet responsibilities.
Represented the NCC at the Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat national camp in Ballari, completing 25 days of training, cultural exchange, and national integration activities.
Participated in the Infosys Global Hackathon and advanced to the regional finals through collaborative problem-solving and prototype development.
Attended the 2025 CATC Camp and led the entire college contingent as a PO Cadet for 12 days, coordinating cadet participation and camp responsibilities.
Represented the VVCE NCC unit at Open Day 2025, where the club secured second runner-up position in the competition.
Won first place in the VVCE Idea Generation competition by presenting and defending an original solution with the team.
Won first place in the VVCE Mini Project Competition for a practical student project presented to the college evaluation panel.
Helped conduct the Code of Duty event as a member of the VectorFlow Club, contributing to planning, coordination, and participant experience.
Won Tech Spark with teammate Aashish, finishing first among 50 teams through a strong idea, prototype, and final presentation.

Won first place in the Education domain at IEEE Anveshan 2025 with AsanMinds. The team cleared regional selection from more than 300 applicants, placed first among 25 regional teams, and won the final among 50 teams.
Secured first place again in Phase 2 of the VVCE Idea Generation competition, extending the team's record of innovation recognition.
Won first place at the IEEE Bar Camp among 40 participating teams through collaborative technical problem-solving and presentation.
Appointed Cadet Captain of VVCE NCC and officially entrusted with leadership of approximately 100 cadets.
Attended a 25-day Sea Training Camp in Mumbai as Cadet Captain, representing Karnataka alongside seven other selected cadets.
Won third place in a project-building competition among the Super 60 students with the team.
Finished runner-up at the Prayog 24-hour hackathon with a cross-disciplinary mechanical team, contributing under a time-limited build challenge.
Won first place in the second phase of the VVCE Mini Project competition for the team's continued project development and presentation.
Conducted an ergonomic model study and gathered industry information to understand practical workplace needs and apply them to the model.
Conducted a rural survey among silk-cloth makers to gather firsthand information and understand local production practices and challenges.
Won second place in the one-day VVCE Idea Generation event with the team through rapid ideation and a focused final presentation.
Organized the Code Hunt event as a student coordinator, helping deliver a competition with approximately 100 participating teams.
Became Vice President of VectorFlow, the department's technical club, supporting operations and student coordination while conducting Vibeathon, a coding event organized through the club.
